text: I feel the quiet hum of collective focus as I look into the meeting room. People seem absorbed in shared tasks or conversations, creating an atmosphere of mutual engagement. In the next space, surrounded by the vibrancy of colors and the boldness of 'R+D,' I sense creative energy and curiosity. The juxtaposition of structured gathering and innovative displays makes me ponder the relationship between discussion, collaboration, and the birth of new ideas. Here, I am both an observer and participant in an unfolding story of learning and progress.
